name: install-docs
body: Install docs: README.md's Install section — front-loaded Homebrew (macOS) and Scoop (Windows) commands for tap/bucket, install and upgrade, followed by manual GitHub Release download as the Linux route and fallback, linking to INSTALL.md (readme-install-front-loading) — and INSTALL.md, the detailed plain-language guide per OS. Neither requires or mentions a GitHub account, repo access or token. README.md is presented as kalide's front page with a brand hero image from `brand/` and links to LICENSE and CHANGELOG.md (readme-presentation).
